# SCA Papers Explorer

> An explorer for the 2,064 papers of the Society of Core Analysts (SCA) symposium, 1987–2026: core analysis and petrophysics (SCAL, wettability, capillary pressure, relative permeability, NMR, digital rock and more), grouped by topic, with in-corpus citations and AI-written summaries. The PDFs are hosted by jgmaas.com and linked from each entry.

- TL;DRs, summaries, keywords and method labels were written by Claude (Sonnet 5.5) from each paper's text and can contain errors; titles, authors and years come from the papers themselves. Check the PDF before relying on a detail.
- Citation counts only cover citations between papers in this corpus.
- Each paper has a page at `https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/#<ID>` (e.g. `#SCA2014-051`) and a PDF link.
- Topics come from clustering text embeddings; method labels are a fixed list of 8.

## Topics

- [Digital rock and pore network modelling](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/digital-rock-and-pore-network-modelling.txt): 229 papers. Keywords: pore, permeability, digital, network, images, porosity
- [NMR relaxation and pore size](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/nmr-relaxation-and-pore-size.txt): 214 papers. Keywords: nmr, relaxation, t2, magnetic resonance, pore, fluid
- [Electrical resistivity and Archie parameters](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/electrical-resistivity-and-archie-parameters.txt): 134 papers. Keywords: resistivity index, electrical, conductivity, water saturation, archie, saturation exponent
- [Core wettability evaluation and restoration](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/core-wettability-evaluation-and-restoration.txt): 105 papers. Keywords: wettability, oil, cleaning, state, contact, amott
- [CO2 storage, hydrates and rock-fluid reactions](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/co2-storage-hydrates-and-rock-fluid-reactions.txt): 104 papers. Keywords: co2 storage, brine, gas, hydrate, permeability, dissolution
- [Coring, core preservation and damage](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/coring-core-preservation-and-damage.txt): 104 papers. Keywords: coring, drilling, mud, damage, invasion, formation
- [Coreflood interpretation and simulation](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/coreflood-interpretation-and-simulation.txt): 79 papers. Keywords: relative permeability, capillary pressure, saturation, unsteady-state, flow, steady-state
- [Core-log petrophysical integration](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/core-log-petrophysical-integration.txt): 78 papers. Keywords: petrophysical, log, porosity, logs, parameters, wells
- [Porous plate and mercury capillary pressure](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/porous-plate-and-mercury-capillary-pressure.txt): 77 papers. Keywords: capillary pressure, saturation, pc, porous plate, mercury, drainage
- [Centrifuge capillary pressure methods](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/centrifuge-capillary-pressure-methods.txt): 73 papers. Keywords: centrifuge, capillary pressure, pressure curves, saturation, pressure curve, drainage
- [Stress, compressibility and acoustic velocity](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/stress-compressibility-and-acoustic-velocity.txt): 70 papers. Keywords: stress, pore pressure, velocity, permeability, porosity, compressibility
- [Nanoparticle, microbial and polymer EOR](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/nanoparticle-microbial-and-polymer-eor.txt): 70 papers. Keywords: nanoparticles, oil recovery, polymer, surfactant, eor, flooding
- [Fractured rock flow and matrix](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/fractured-rock-flow-and-matrix.txt): 61 papers. Keywords: fracture, fractures, fractured, matrix, flow, permeability
- [Low salinity waterflooding mechanisms](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/low-salinity-waterflooding-mechanisms.txt): 61 papers. Keywords: salinity water, oil recovery, brine, waterflooding, injection, wettability alteration

- [Crude oil-brine-rock wettability chemistry](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/crude-oil-brine-rock-wettability-chemistry.txt): 37 papers. Keywords: crude oil, wettability, contact angle, surface, asphaltene, wetting
- [Spontaneous imbibition oil recovery](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/spontaneous-imbibition-oil-recovery.txt): 35 papers. Keywords: spontaneous imbibition, oil recovery, initial water, counter-current, face, open

- [NMR wettability characterization](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms/nmr-wettability-characterization.txt): 25 papers. Keywords: wettability, nmr, relaxation time, t2, oil, water

## Data

- [All papers, one line each](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/llms-full.txt): ID, year, title, all authors, method, keywords and TL;DR, grouped by topic
- [papers.json](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/data/papers.json): the site's full data as JSON (abstracts, map coordinates, PageRank, citation and similar-paper links)
- [topics.json](https://mralbu.github.io/sca-papers/data/topics.json): topic names, keywords and sizes

## Optional

- [SCA papers on jgmaas.com](https://www.jgmaas.com/SCA/): the original PDF archive
